whySupported: The observation reports only that the saved record passed the preexisting original submitted contract. It does not describe unrecorded actions, assume freedom from help, claim a general theorem or assess understanding. Requiring original submitted() unchanged preserves family-specific proof and Check conditions.

findings.fact: All16 P007 bindings have no method or question properties. Other97 families/335 positions have method:null and a nonempty question after required original lazy loading. No candidate binding emitted a non-null method.
findings.impact: A literal bound.method===null gate copied from #350 excludes all30 P007 positions; directly using bound.question produces undefined.
findings.fix: In the new isolated composition only, allow absent method as no-method, output method:null, retain rejection of an explicit non-null method, and use an explicitly reviewed neutral question fallback when original question is absent. Do not change original bindings or submitted contracts.

findings.scope: Use of binding.question before successful submitted evidence
findings.fact: Several existing questions contain the original answer (for example P062 60800, P0691500克, P07026cm, P07994/96cm²), so copying them into a guide visible before Check changes the learning flow.
findings.impact: Pre-Check guide reuse can disclose the answer. This is a new integration/presentation issue, not a defect in the original post-result mathematical contract.
findings.fix: Use binding.question only as feedback.connection after unchanged submitted() succeeds. Use a neutral question for the optional guide; no need to individually rewrite all family questions.
findings.neutralGuideQuestion: 哪些记录能帮助你核对这次结果？

findings.fact: Original B39 tasks are lazy-loaded. Before ensureB39Ready, sessionTaskFor is undefined; after original ensureB39Ready all six bindings expose method:null and a nonempty question.
findings.fix: Preserve native lazy readiness. Do not cache a missing task or null binding at module import time; introspection/tests should await the same original ready function.
A single Map(type->oneFamily) cannot scale #350. Match the exact source key and call that original binding; retain uniqueness semantics and reject ambiguous matches.
